resources.string: 100% on-device · No cloud · No accounts · No ads
Two products — pick the one that matches how you watch
SenseVoice on-device · any app · ~2 s phrase windows. Faster than Quality; not burned-in-sub accuracy.
whisper.cpp · cleaner text · updates every few seconds on mid devices. Balanced uses Tiny for keep-up; Accurate is Small.
Near real-time captions over any app (~2 s SenseVoice windows). Uses the Fast SenseVoice model only. Faster than Quality; phrase-level, not burned-in-sub perfect.
Higher-accuracy captions with whisper.cpp. Balanced (Tiny) keeps up better on mid devices; Accurate (Small) is slower/cleaner. Multilingual via auto; EN target on English content uses a fast path.
Pick languages and caption font below. Start opens model choice, then live captions.
Save subtitles to a text file
When on, each live session writes a .txt file under the app Documents/captions folder on this device. Local only.
Captions float above videos and games. Android needs “display over other apps” so the bubble can stay visible while you watch something else.
Caption Action captions sounds playing on your device (videos, games, media) — never your microphone. Android still requires this permission for screen-audio capture. Audio never leaves your phone.
A quiet notification keeps the live session running in the background.
Android’s screen-capture prompt lets Caption Action hear app playback (YouTube, games, media). Captions use device audio only — never the microphone. Allow screen sharing or the session cannot start.
Permissions ready — tap Start live captions again to begin.
Allow screen sharing to caption device audio
Allow screen sharing to caption device audio
Caption Action requires Android 10+ for device audio
Fast — SenseVoice multilingual (~228 MB) · Live path
Balanced — ggml Tiny Q5 (~31 MB) · Quality keep-up
Accurate — ggml Small (~182 MB) · Quality path
Live uses Fast (SenseVoice). Quality uses Balanced or Accurate (whisper.cpp). Models stay on your phone; interrupted downloads can resume.
